items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: KeAndre Lambert-Smith (hamstring) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: KeAndre Lambert-Smith (hamstring) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The team recently opened up Lambert-Smith's 21-day practice window. He was able to participate in a limited fashion on Wednesday, and there's a chance that he will suit up and play in Week 6, though we won't know if that will be the case or not until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brenen Thompson (quad) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Brenen Thompson (quad) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Thompson was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday. If he's active in Week 6, he could see more work than usual with Ladd McConkey (foot), Tre Harris' (hamstring), and Quentin Johnston (chest) all uncertain to play for the Chargers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Marquez Valdes-Scantling (rib) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Marquez Valdes-Scantling (rib) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran wasn't able to log a full practice on Wednesday, as he was left limited by a rib issue of some kind. He remains off of the fantasy radar moving forward, regardless of his injury status heading into Week 6.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ladd McConkey (foot) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Ladd McConkey (foot) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: McConkey was unable to see any real action last week due to his foot issue. He was able to practice on Wednesday to start the week this week, but he remained limited due to the same injury. He may play through it in Week 6, but it's hard for fantasy managers to trust starting him at this point in the season, even if his health is improving.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Charlie Kolar (arm) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Charlie Kolar (arm) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran tight end made his return to the lineup in Week 4 after missing a couple of weeks with a forearm injury. He looked good and is now a full participant at practice, so fantasy managers can safely speculate that he is back to close health at this point.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Quentin Johnston (chest) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Quentin Johnston (chest) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Johnston was not able to play last week due to a chest injury that he's dealing with. He was able to practice on Wednesday, however, which is a good sign that he will be back for Week 6. If he's active, he may see more work than usual if Tre' Harris (hamstring) or Ladd McConkey (foot) are ruled out for Sunday's game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tre' Harris (hamstring) officially doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Tre' Harris (hamstring) officially did not take part in Los Angeles' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Harris is considered week-to-week with a hamstring injury right now, so it's no surprise that he was sidelined at practice on Wednesday. Fantasy managers should look for Quentin Johnston (chest) to see a bit more work if the young wideout is sidelined this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyler Smith (thumb) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Tyler Smith (thumb) practiced in full on Wednesday.
items.impact: Smith was recently able to make his return to the lineup after missing some time due to a thumb issue. He was able to practice in full on Wednesday as well, so it looks like he's truly past this issue at this point in the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyler Guyton (back) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Tyler Guyton (back) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: The young offensive lineman was able to practice in full on Wednesday, which puts him on track to be 100% healthy for Week 6. That's good news for Dallas' offense ahead of a matchup against the Packers this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Porter was left limited at practice on Wednesday due to an ankle issue of some kind that he's dealing with. It's unclear if it will affect his availability for Week 6 or not, but we should know more sometime within the next day or two.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Skyy Moore (ankle) a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Skyy Moore (ankle) was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Moore suffered an ankle injury last week. He wasn't able to practice on Wednesday as a result, and it looks like it may very well leave him sidelined in Week 6. His absence wouldn't have much of an impact on Green Bay's lineup, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Savion Williams (ankle) considered limited Wednesday
items.desc: Savion Williams (ankle) was considered a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Williams was able to practice on Wednesday, although he remained limited due to an ankle issue. His status for Week 6 is undetermined at this point, but either way he remains off of the fantasy radar for the time being.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lukas Van Ness (shoulder) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Lukas Van Ness (shoulder) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: Van Ness has been dealing with this shoulder injury for a while, but he was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Wednesday, meaning that it should be a non-issue for him moving forward. Green Bay's defense will benefit from him being at full health.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jacob Monk (quad) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Jacob Monk (quad) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Monk was a limited participant on Wednesday due to his nagging quad issue. He may play in Week 6, however, which would be great news for an injury-riddled Packers' offensive line.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Davis Allen (foot) a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Davis Allen (foot) was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: A foot injury left Allen sidelined on Wednesday. That's not a great sign for his Week 6 status, but we won't know his availability for sure until sometime later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Colby Parkinson (shoulder) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Colby Parkinson (shoulder) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran is still dealing with his shoulder issue and was limited on Wednesday as a result. He seems likely to play through it in Week 6, however, and will see more work than usual with Terrance Ferguson (ankle) out and Davis Allen (foot) trending towards being sidelined for the Rams.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Emmanuel Pregnon (toe) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Emmanuel Pregnon (toe) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jacksonville's starting lineman is uncertain to play in Week 6. He was limited on Wednesday due to a toe issue, and if it leaves him sidelined on Sunday, the Jaguars' offensive line will be weaker than usual ahead of a matchup against the Texans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cole Van Lanen (knee) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Cole Van Lanen (knee) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Van Lanen was limited at another practice due to his ongoing knee issue. The team has made a habit of limiting his workload in practice, but he has been playing through the injury and should be able to do so again in Week 6, barring setbacks.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nate Boerkircher (back) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Nate Boerkircher (back) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie is managing a back issue of some kind and was left limited at the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday as a result. He's not fantasy relevant at this point, so his potential absence in Week 6 wouldn't have a big impact for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jake Matthews (groin) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Jake Matthews (groin) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: Matthews logged a full practice session to start the week on Wednesday, which indicates that his groin is a non-issue after he played through it in Week 5. He should play on Sunday, which is great news for the Falcons ahead of a competitive matchup against the Bears this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Za'Darius Smith (concussion/neck) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Za'Darius Smith (concussion/neck) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Smith is still going through the NFL's concussion protocols, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, which is a good sign for his availability for Week 6. Atlanta's defense will see a nice boost if he's available to play this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: Penix injured his ribs last week, but it doesn't seem to be a serious issue, as he was able to practice in full on Wednesday and told reporters that he will be 'good to play' this week. He should be available to start for the Falcons, which is great news for the fantasy value of Drake London, Bijan Robinson, and all of Atlanta's skill-position players this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Al-Shaair was held out of the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday as he continues to manage a lingering groin issue. He should be available play in Week 6, however, which is great news for Houston's defense ahead of a divisional matchup against the Jaguars.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trent Brown (knee) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Trent Brown (knee) missed Houston's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Brown was unable to practice on Wednesday due to a nagging knee issue that he's managing. He should play through it in Week 6, however, assuming he doesn't further aggravate the issue throughout the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Montgomery (groin) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: David Montgomery (groin) did not take part in Houston's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Montgomery recently suffered a groin injury and wasn't able to practice on Wednesday, which isn't surprising since he is considered week-to-week at this point. Woody Marks is expected to be Houston's top running back this week and will likely be a viable fantasy option in a matchup against the Jaguars.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tank Dell (knee) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Tank Dell (knee) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: Dell was able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday and continues to draw closer and closer to a return from a knee injury that has left him sidelined for a significant amount of time. He could play this week, but that isn't likely to be determined until sometime after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dee Alford (ankle) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Dee Alford (ankle) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Alford was sidelined in Week 5 due to an ankle injury, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, which puts him on track to make his return in Week 6. Buffalo's defense will see a nice boost to their secondary if he's active against the Raiders.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ed Oliver (knee) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ed Oliver (knee) missed Buffalo's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The Bills were without Oliver at practice on Wednesday, as he sat out due to a knee issue that he's dealing with. He should be available to play in Week 6, however, assuming he makes his return to practice on Thursday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joshua Palmer (shoulder) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Joshua Palmer (shoulder) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: A shoulder injury left Palmer limited at practice on Wednesday. It's not considered a serious issue, however, so it isn't likely to leave him sidelined in Week 6. He would see more work in Sunday's game in the off-chance that DJ Moore (shoulder) is unable to suit up for Buffalo.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: DJ Moore (shoulder) did not take part in Buffalo's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Moore was sidelined at practice on Wednesday. The team held him out due to a shoulder injury that has been bothering him for a while, but it seems likely that he will return to practice on Thursday and play through it in Week 6, assuming he doesn't suffer any setbacks throughout the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ty Johnson (hamstring) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Ty Johnson (hamstring) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Johnson was left limited at practice on Wednesday due to a hamstring injury that he's still managing. It shouldn't affect his availability for Week 6, however, unless he suffers a setback at some point in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ashton Jeanty (foot) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ashton Jeanty (foot) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: There has been some recent speculation that Jeanty is not at full health, but while he is listed on Las Vegas' injury report, he was able to practice in full on Wednesday and should be good to go for Week 6. Fantasy managers should continue to start him, but after a slow start to the season, they should have tempered expectations for his efficiency for the foreseeable future.
